split_rule: chronological 70/15/15; purge training label windows crossing next split boundary
social_feature_contract: Latest completed publication month collected before decision_at; mapped by city/district and recipe menu; unknown locations excluded.
sentiment_split_rule: By collected_at; pending batches beyond simulation end excluded from training/evaluation.
sentiment_eligibility_rule: Use training_status=eligible only. Canonical text deduplication retains earliest ingested occurrence; later duplicates/conflicts excluded without moving time partitions.
sentiment_provenance: synthetic Instagram-like Indonesian menu discussion; not real scraping or cafe reviews
